name: Treewalker (Akashic)
body:
You can run up trees and other living vertical surfaces as though they were solid ground.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15 or veilweaver level 1, ability to bind veils to your feet slot.

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to fuse a small portion of your life energy to that of other living creatures, enabling you to briefly bind your hands and feet to trees, plants, and other non-sentient living things, allowing you to move up and down the surfaces of these as though you had a climb speed equal to your base land speed.
